records.context: spaCR measures each cell on its own, but an infected cell can change the phenotype of its neighbours. Without a neighbourhood column, an uninfected cell touching an infected one and an uninfected cell on the far side of the microplate sample position are indistinguishable rows.

records.source: spaCR measures each cell on its own, but an infected cell can change the phenotype of its neighbours. Without a neighbourhood column, an uninfected cell touching an infected one and an uninfected cell on the far side of the well are indistinguishable rows.
records.translation: spaCR mesure chaque cellule isolément, mais une cellule infectée peut modifier le phénotype de ses voisines. Sans colonne de voisinage, une cellule non infectée au contact d’une cellule infectée et une cellule non infectée située à l’autre bout du puits sont des lignes indiscernables.

records.context: This has two consequences. A bystander phenotype cannot be detected, because no column separates a bystander from a distant uninfected cell. In addition, if bystanders are phenotypically shifted and pooled into "uninfected", the control population is a mixture: its variance is inflated and the effect size of every infection comparison is reduced.

records.translation: Cela a deux conséquences. Un phénotype de cellule voisine ne peut pas être détecté, car aucune colonne ne distingue une cellule voisine d’une cellule non infectée éloignée. records.context: SQLite's ``PRAGMA user_version`` is the on-disk schema version.  Migrations are registered here as a contiguous, ordered sequence and are applied in one transaction.  A database created by an older spaCR release therefore follows the same path whether it is opened for reading or for writing, while a database created by a newer release is rejected before any mutation.

A database created by an older spaCR release therefore follows the same path whether it is opened for reading or for writing, while a database created by a newer release is rejected before any mutation.
records.translation: Le ``PRAGMA user_version`` de SQLite est la version du schéma sur disque. Les migrations sont enregistrées ici sous forme d’une séquence contiguë et ordonnée, et sont appliquées dans une seule transaction. Une base de données créée par une version plus ancienne de spaCR suit donc le même chemin qu’elle soit ouverte en lecture ou en écriture, tandis qu’une base de données créée par une version plus récente est rejetée avant toute modification.

records.context: Both estimates are always computed, and one of them is chosen as follows. The watershed estimate is taken when the transform resolved something *and* either the threshold path kept nothing at all, or the field is dense enough for fusion to be the explanation (foreground at or above ``fused_fraction``) *and* the transform resolves at least five times as many objects. A count disagreement alone is therefore never fusion — a hollow, membrane-only object is one correct component by area but shatters into dozens of arcs under the distance transform, so a bare ratio test would discard the right answer in favour of the wall thickness. A high foreground fraction alone is not fusion either — a dense but well-separated field can reach 30% foreground and still be measured correctly by thresholding — so on its own it only brings the confidence down while the threshold estimate stands. An empty threshold result *is* taken as fusion on its own, with no density check, because no threshold estimate is left to stand; if the transform resolved nothing either, no estimate is returned for that channel. When fusion is not declared and the two estimates disagree by more than 1.5-fold, the confidence is downgraded and the note says so, because that disagreement indicates that neither number is reliable on its own.

records.source: Both estimates are always computed, and one of them is chosen as follows. The watershed estimate is taken when the transform resolved something *and* either the threshold path kept nothing at all, or the field is dense enough for fusion to be the explanation (foreground at or above ``fused_fraction``) *and* the transform resolves at least five times as many objects. A count disagreement alone is therefore never fusion — a hollow, membrane-only object is one correct component by area but shatters into dozens of arcs under the distance transform, so a bare ratio test would discard the right answer in favour of the wall thickness. A high foreground fraction alone is not fusion either — a dense but well-separated field can reach 30% foreground and still be measured correctly by thresholding — so on its own it only brings the confidence down while the threshold estimate stands. An empty threshold result *is* taken as fusion on its own, with no density check, because no threshold estimate is left to stand; if the transform resolved nothing either, no estimate is returned for that channel. When fusion is not declared and the two estimates disagree by more than 1.5-fold, the confidence is downgraded and the note says so, because that disagreement indicates that neither number is reliable on its own.
records.translation: Les deux estimations sont toujours calculées, et l’une d’elles est choisie comme suit. L’estimation par watershed est retenue lorsque la transformée a résolu quelque chose *et* que, soit le chemin par seuillage n’a rien conservé, soit le champ est suffisamment dense pour que la fusion soit l’explication (premier plan supérieur ou égal à ``fused_fraction``) *et* que la transformée résout au moins cinq fois plus d’objets. Un désaccord sur le nombre ne suffit donc jamais à conclure à une fusion — un objet creux, réduit à sa membrane, est une composante correcte selon l’aire, mais se fragmente en dizaines d’arcs sous la transformée de distance ; un simple test de rapport écarterait donc la bonne réponse au profit de l’épaisseur de la paroi. Une fraction élevée de premier plan ne suffit pas non plus à conclure à une fusion — un champ dense mais bien séparé peut atteindre 30% de premier plan et rester correctement mesuré par seuillage —, si bien qu’à elle seule elle ne fait que réduire la confiance, tandis que l’estimation par seuillage est conservée. Un résultat de seuillage vide *est*, à lui seul, interprété comme une fusion, sans vérification de densité, car il ne reste aucune estimation par seuillage ; si la transformée n’a rien résolu non plus, aucune estimation n’est renvoyée pour ce canal. Lorsque la fusion n’est pas déclarée et que les deux estimations divergent de plus d’un facteur 1.5, la confiance est abaissée et la note le signale, car ce désaccord indique qu’aucun des deux nombres n’est fiable à lui seul.
